GlobalPolicy.source-of-truth: Verify the target chain media_asset -> collection/inbox -> immutable selection_snapshot -> analysis_run -> artifacts and the independent media_asset -> export_job -> transient delivery chain, plus channel_account/channel_surface recovery where channels render state.
GlobalPolicy.access-scope: The target product is single-user; verification must prove channel_account isolation, no accidental multi-user/workspace dependency, and no cross-channel mutation through stale callback or stale idempotency data.
GlobalPolicy.diagnostics-policy: Rejected and partially processed records must produce stable diagnostics instead of disappearing.
GlobalPolicy.retention-policy: Retention checks must prove metadata, stored object bodies, artifacts, diagnostics, and selection snapshots follow their separate lifecycle rules.
GlobalPolicy.coverage-policy: Coverage closure is reported per surface with the metric each tool can actually emit; missing metrics remain explicit gaps and do not collapse into a fake repo-wide 100% claim.
GlobalPolicy.target-coverage-policy: For the target rebuild, 100% means every declared table invariant, API operation, deleted-alias rule, user flow, worker step, channel surface recovery path, and diagnostic failure mode has explicit automated or runtime proof.
GlobalPolicy.asr-runtime-policy: For transcription, 100% means CopperASR is proven as the only active ASR backend across worker runtime, compose, dependencies, env, adapters, service artifacts, diagnostics, and no-legacy guardrails.
GlobalPolicy.data-reset-policy: The current local database is disposable. Verification should prove clean schema reset/recreate, deterministic seed fixtures, and target behavior from fresh data; it must not require preserving or backfilling current local rows.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never assert on raw secrets, raw bot tokens, private object URLs, or full prompt payloads.

FailureTaxonomy.failure: Input is unsupported, unreadable, too large, unsafe, or missing required metadata.
Caller attempts to read or mutate another channel account resource.
Mutable collection operation used a stale version.
Selection snapshot references unavailable, deleted, quarantined, or cross-channel-account media_asset records.
analysis_run creation was attempted from an unsealed selection_snapshot.
Run cannot access a required stored object because retention, deletion, or remote resolution removed it.
A later step needs a transcript or text-corpus artifact that does not exist yet.
A prerequisite transcription or text preparation step failed.
A prerequisite cannot be scheduled because the input kind, retention state, or provider contract makes it unavailable.
The CopperASR runtime is not healthy, unreachable, or not configured for the worker.
CopperASR rejected or could not decode the provided audio object.
CopperASR returned an unexpected runtime error; the platform must still record ASR diagnostics and run policy artifacts without falling back to generic backend-unavailable user loops.
CopperASR completed but produced no speech transcript for the input.
The CopperASR request exceeded the worker timeout budget.
Internal execution failed and produced diagnostic context.
Artifact is failed, expired, deleted, or not yet published.
Retention action violates audit, channel-account access, or lifecycle rules.
Provider identity or current media could not be safely resolved.
An export exhausted its fenced retry budget.
An adapter delivery attempt failed and remains retryable or expired by policy.
A fenced physical object deletion failed and is scheduled for bounded retry.
Managed orphan, stale publication, missing body, or stale delete claim was reconciled.
Metadata expected an available body but the managed object is absent.
Attempt scratch cleanup failed; product terminal status remains unchanged and periodic cleanup retries.
